name: Rime (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to rime is a connection to the cold in the world. They are suffused with the energies of the biting cold, night, and darkness.

Manifestation: The conduit’s connection to the rime can manifest in many ways, a constant cold body temperature, white of icy-blue eyes, a cold mist rising from one’s body, or constant visible breath mist regardless of temperature.

Communing: Communing with rime could be exposing themselves to a cold environment, staying in shade or darkness, enjoying night air, or enjoying cold food or beverages.

Connection Spells: (1st-level/0th) – ray of frost (2nd-level/1st) – icicle dagger (4th-level/2nd) – darkness (6th-level/3rd) – deeper darkness (8th-level/4th) – creeping ice (10th-level/5th) – cone of cold (12th-level/6th) – freezing sphere (14th-level/7th) – hungry darkness (16th-level/8th) – polar ray (18th-level/9th) – polar midnight

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with the cold and/or darkness descriptors.

Primal Empathy: The conduit may communicate with animals from cold regions and creatures with the cold subtype (such as ice elementals and some outsiders).

Natural Skill: Survival

Natural Movement: The conduit does not need to make Balance checks on ice or snow and their base speed is increased by 5 feet when in contact with such terrain.

Hand of Frost (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they deal 1 cold damage with any melee attacks they make and 1 additional cold damage per spell level of any spell that deals cold damage they cast.

Additionally, they can expend a primal point to launch a beam of frost, making a ranged touch attack with a range of 60 feet. On a hit, they deal 1d8 cold damage per two class levels they possess. If the conduit has 1 primal point remaining after expending a point in this way, the cold damage dealt is increased by 1 per d8 of dice damage dealt. This ray of cold then creates difficult terrain in the square under the target for 1d4 rounds.

Rime-Born (Ex)

At 5th level, so long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they gain a cold resistance of 10. At 13th level, this becomes immunity.

Additionally, the conduit has a bonus on saves vs. cold environments equal to their class level regardless of if they have any primal points remaining.

Frozen Darkness (Su)

Starting with 9th level, the conduit can add a deathly cold to any darkness spell they cast. As a swift action, the conduit can expend a primal point when casting a spell with the darkness descriptor to deal 1d6 cold damage to any creature beginning their turn within or entering the area of the darkness effect. This ability cannot be used on instantaneous effects.

This damage per round increases to 2d6 at 12th level, 3d6 at 15th level and finally 4d6 at 18th level.

Piercing Cold (Su)

Starting with 13th level, you can expend a primal point as a swift action to remove any cold resistance a target within 60 feet may have. If the target has immunity, it is instead reduced to a resistance to cold 10. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

Of Cold and Dark (Ex)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the hand of frost or rime-born abilities and the damage dealt by the ray of cold produced by hand of frost increases to 1d8 per class level.

Additionally, any creature within 5 feet of you gain your immunity to fire provided by rime-born.
